title: LGD Assembly Constituency register
description: Authoritative register of Vidhan Sabha Assembly Constituencies keyed on the LGD numeric ac_id (Ministry of Panchayati Raj). FK to lgd_states.json on lgd_state_id and lgd_pcs.json on lgd_pc_id (nullable when LGD does not record a parent PC). ECI ac_no is NOT carried here per ADR-0049 - the ECI<->LGD join lives in datasets/taxonomy/ac_crosswalk.parquet.

x-changelog.summary: Initial schema. 3918 ACs from LGD Constituency Coverage Report snapshot 2026-06-01. Delhi (70 ACs) missing from source report - documented gap.

lgd_ac_id.description: LGD numeric AC id. Globally unique across India.

lgd_pc_id.description: FK to lgd_pcs.json:lgd_pc_id. Nullable when LGD does not record a parent PC for this AC.
